manual.description: Creates or deletes the Real DMP indicator file Yes.txt.

VAR_CoreActionOutcome.description: Tracks the outcome of the actual Operating State/Environment switch itself, independent of AuditOutcome, so the Power App response reflects the core action's real result even if unrelated housekeeping (mailbox folder setup) fails afterwards.

VAR_NewStepsCount.description: Holds the incremented Steps counter value while writing it to Agent Audit Summary.

VAR_NewRunsCount.description: Holds the incremented Runs counter value while writing it to Agent Audit Summary.

VAR_AlertTargetFolderId.description: Stores the Outlook folder id of the Agent 5 alert evidence folder. Used for moving alert mails.

VAR_AlertMailSubject.description: Stores the subject of the alert mail so it can be reused for the Sent Items lookup and move operation.

VAR_AlertMessageId.description: Stores the message id of the sent alert mail so it can be moved to the Agent 5 Alerts folder.

RESPOND_Result.description: Returns execution result to Power Apps.

parameters.$filter: Active eq 'Yes' and (((Scope eq 'Global') and (Title eq 'CurrentOperationMode' or Title eq 'AlertEmailRecipient' or Title eq 'SharedDMPMailbox')) or (Scope eq 'Agent 05'))

GET_DMP_Command_Configuration.description: Loads active DMP COMMAND configuration items.

FILTER_Config_CurrentOperationMode.description: Finds current DMP COMMAND operation mode.

VAR_OperationMode.description: Stores current DMP COMMAND operation mode.

Select_ConfigEntries.description: Maps each configuration row to a mode-resolved JSON key-value fragment, replacing the slow per-row loop with a single non-looping data operation.

CMP_ConfigJsonText.description: Completes the configuration JSON text by wrapping all resolved property fragments in braces.

CMP_ConfigObject.description: Converts the generated configuration JSON text into the central configuration object for this run.

Get_DMP_Mailbox_Parent_Folder_ID.description: Resolves the mailbox folder ID of the processed-mails root folder so that the Agent 5 alerts subfolder can later be created and addressed.

Create_Mailbox_Subfolder_\"PA_Processed_.description: Creates the processed-mails root folder in the shared mailbox if it does not yet exist.

Create_Mailbox_Subfolder_\"Agent_5_Alert.description: Creates the dedicated Agent 5 Alerts mailbox subfolder below the processed-mails root folder if it does not yet exist.

Get_DMP_Mailbox_Subfolder_ID_for_\"Agent.description: Resolves the mailbox folder ID of the Agent 5 Alerts mailbox subfolder so that sent internal Agent 5 alert mails can later be moved there.

SET_AlertTargetFolderId.description: Stores the mailbox folder ID of the Agent 5 Alerts folder for moving sent alert mails.

E-Mail_Folder_creation.description: Ensures the Agent 5 Alerts mailbox evidence folder exists and resolves its folder id.

UPDATE_ConfigRow_CurrentOperationMode.description: Writes the new Operating State selected in the Power App back to the central configuration.

SET_AuditOutcome_Succeeded.description: Marks the run outcome as successful after the configuration update.

SET_CoreActionOutcome_Succeeded.description: Marks the core Operating State/Environment switch as successful, independent of any later housekeeping (mailbox folder) outcome.

AUDIT_ConfigUpdate_Success.description: Buffers the successful Operating State update as an audit event.

AUDIT_ConfigUpdate_Failure.description: Buffers the failed Operating State update as an audit event.

SET_AuditOutcome_Failed.description: Marks the run outcome as failed when the configuration update did not succeed.

SET_CoreActionOutcome_Failed.description: Marks the core Operating State/Environment switch as failed so the Power App correctly reports failure only when the actual switch itself did not succeed.

SET_AuditOutcome_EmailFolderFailed.description: Marks the run outcome as Failed when the mailbox evidence folder setup did not succeed. Treated as critical because it breaks housekeeping/archiving of processed alert mails, even if the Operating State update itself succeeded.

value.KeyOutput: Mailbox evidence folder setup (PA Processed Mails / Agent 5 Alerts) failed - housekeeping/archiving of processed alert mails is affected until this is resolved.

AUDIT_EmailFolderCreation_Failed.description: Buffers a Failed audit event when the mailbox evidence folder setup did not succeed, so the Cockpit surfaces this as Critical even though the Operating State update itself succeeded.

SET_AlertMailSubject_(EmailFolderCreatio.description: Builds the subject of the email-folder-creation-failed alert mail.

parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Agent 5 - Mailbox evidence folder setup failed.


The shared mailbox subfolders used for evidence/housekeeping ("PA Processed Mails" / "Agent 5 Alerts") could not be created or resolved. Housekeeping/archiving of processed alert mails will not work correctly until this is resolved.


Initiated By: @{variables('InitiatedBy')}
Run ID: @{workflow()?['run']?['name']}

Please check the shared mailbox permissions and folder structure.

MAIL_Alert_(EmailFolderCreationFailed).description: Sends a critical alert mail when the mailbox evidence folder setup failed, so the operations team is notified without needing to actively monitor the Cockpit.

inputs.name: AlertMailSubject
inputs.value: [Agent 5][FAILED] Operational State Update - Config Write Failed

SET_AlertMailSubject_(ConfigUpdateFailed.description: Builds the subject of the config-update-failed alert mail so it can later be reused for the Sent Items lookup and move operation.

parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Agent 5 - Operating State update failed.


The requested operational mode change could not be written to the central configuration.


Requested Mode: @{variables('RequestedAction')}
Initiated By: @{variables('InitiatedBy')}
Run ID: @{workflow()?['run']?['name']}

Please check the Audit Trail and SharePoint list permissions.

MAIL_Alert_(ConfigUpdateFailed).description: Sends an alert mail when the Operating State update fails to write to the central configuration.

Delay_Before_Get_Sent_Email_(ConfigUpdat.description: Waits before searching Sent Items so that the alert mail can be indexed and found reliably.

Get_Sent_Email_By_Subject_(ConfigUpdateF.description: Searches Sent Items for the Agent 5 config-update-failed alert mail using the exact subject stored in AlertMailSubject.

SET_AlertMessageId__(ConfigUpdateFailed).description: Stores the message id of the sent config-update-failed alert mail so it can be moved to the Agent 5 Alerts folder.

Move_Email_(ConfigUpdateFailed).description: Moves the Agent 5 alert mail from Sent Items to the Agent 5 Alerts folder.

SCOPE_AuditTrail_Write.description: Writes buffered audit events and updates the Agent_05 dashboard status record.

WRITE_RunSummary_To_AuditTrail.description: Writes the final Agent 5 run summary to the central audit trail after the configuration update has completed.

GET_AgentSummaryRow_ForStep.description: Reads Agent 5's current Steps counters from Agent Audit Summary.

SET_NewStepsCount.description: Computes the incremented Steps counter value for this event's StepStatus.

PATCH_AgentSummaryRow_ForStep.description: Persists the incremented Steps counter and its last-update timestamp for this event's StepStatus back to Agent Audit Summary.

GET_AgentSummaryRow_ForRun.description: Reads Agent 5's current Runs counters from Agent Audit Summary.

SET_NewRunsCount.description: Computes the incremented Runs counter value based on this run's final AuditOutcome.

PATCH_AgentSummaryRow_ForRun.description: Persists the incremented Runs counter and its last-update timestamp for this run's final AuditOutcome back to Agent Audit Summary.

GET_StatusRow_Agent_05.description: Reads the Agent_05 dashboard status record from DMP Command Agent Status.

UPDATE_StatusRow_Agent_05.description: Updates the Agent_05 dashboard status record with the current run outcome.

VAR_StatusListName.description: Stores the SharePoint list used by DMP COMMAND to display current operational status information.

VAR_StatusAgentKey.description: Stores the unique dashboard identifier of Agent 5.
